_readme: Corrections to ESPN's injury report, by season. Return dates normally come from https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries (see src/fantasy_football/data/espn_injuries.py); add an entry here only when the news is ahead of ESPN. Entries ALWAYS beat ESPN, so a stale one silently overrides a fresher date: delete it once ESPN catches up or the player is back. Give return_date (YYYY-MM-DD, resolved to the player's own team's first game on or after it) or return_week, plus team (e.g. NE) when using a date.
